pillars.prevention: its title or objective speaks of flammability, ignition, flame spread or material screening
pillars.detection: its title or objective speaks of smoke, aerosols, particulates or detection (a smoke point is a soot property, not detection)
pillars.suppression: its title names suppression or extinguishment, or its objective names fire suppressants

facet_rules.oxygen: its table has a row on the atmosphere map
facet_rules.pressure: at least one of those rows states pressure
facet_rules.flow: its table has a column for the ambient air flow
facet_rules.outcome: its table has a column that says what happened

note: A score orders reading. It is built from the stated rules below and the weights the reader sets. It is not a probability and not a safety rating.
near_rule: within 0.03 in oxygen fraction and 15% in pressure

factors.label: Tested near this atmosphere
factors.rule: Rows of its tables near the oxygen and pressure of the mission. Ten or more rows score 1. Rows that state oxygen but no pressure count half.

factors.label: Burns what a cabin is made of
factors.rule: Solid materials 1; a gas burner built to emulate solids and liquids 0.6; liquid droplets 0.5; smoke and aerosol studies 0.4; gas flames 0.35.

factors.label: Gravity of the data
factors.rule: How directly the gravity of the tests matches the mission. No PSI record was taken in lunar or Martian gravity, so none scores 1 for the Moon or Mars.

factors.label: Varies the airflow
factors.rule: 1 when a column for the air moving past the fuel (air flow, flow or inlet velocity, fan setting, flow direction) changes between tests; 0.5 when such a column holds one value. A burner's own fuel or oxidizer feed does not count.

factors.label: Records what happened
factors.rule: 1 when the table has a column for an outcome such as extinction, burn time, burn length, spread or ignition.

factors.label: Informs fire detection
factors.rule: 1 for smoke and aerosol measurements; 0.6 when the table records combustion gases (CO, CO2).

factors.label: Number of tests
factors.rule: Test rows on a logarithmic scale; 300 rows or more score 1.

factors.label: Data held in PSI
factors.rule: Size of the record's files in PSI on a logarithmic scale; a terabyte or more scores 1.

factors.label: Free of data cautions
factors.rule: 1 with no curator caution on the record; each kind of caution takes a third off.

factors.label: Publications listed
factors.rule: Publications listed in the record; twenty or more score 1.
